paras: The Enggano cuckoo-dove (Macropygia cinnamomea) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to Enggano Island in Indonesia. Until 2016, it was considered a subspecies of the ruddy cuckoo-dove.
The Enggano cuckoo-dove is endemic to the Indonesian island of Enggano, off the southwestern coast of Sumatra.
